items.why: Leading a chip selloff as the hot CPI report puts another Fed rate hike back in play and drags tech lower.
Sliding with the chip complex; Investing.com asks why NVIDIA is dropping today amid the inflation driven tech rout.
Mega cap tech caught in the broad selloff as the market heads for its worst day since July.

market_note: Futures pointing lower; VIX surging as the hot inflation read hits tech.
summary: A hot CPI report is punishing stocks, with the market on track for its worst day since July. Tech and chips are leading the losses while VIX spikes.
